title: Event buses, rules and targets
claim: Events from AWS services, your applications and SaaS partners land on event buses, and rules send matching events to their targets.
alt: Three sources on the left: an AWS service, an application and a SaaS partner. The AWS service sends to the default event bus, the application to a custom event bus, and the SaaS partner to a partner event bus. Rules on the default and partner buses point to targets such as a Lambda function, an SQS queue and an SNS topic; an event on the custom bus matches no rule.

edges.label: event
edges.say: When an AWS service sends an event, it goes to your account's default event bus.

edges.label: event
edges.say: Your applications can send custom events, and SaaS partners send events to partner event buses.
Each rule matches incoming events for a given event bus.
A matching event goes to every target of the rule, processed in parallel.

edges.label: no match
edges.say: If an event matches no rule, EventBridge takes no action.
